title: tk cloud run --tick-ids: reach the cloud-wave path from the CLI
description: From b6e gap 1. The per-tick-container path is only reachable by POSTing to /api/runs directly with tick_ids in the body; tk cloud run has no flag for it. Add one, and while there decide what it means to combine it with --queue: b6e refuses queue plus tick_ids with a 400 rather than accepting it and losing the wave on later ignition (the RunRoom queued-submission storage has no tick_ids column), so the CLI should refuse it clearly rather than let the operator discover it as an HTTP error.
notes: 2026-08-22 06:47 - Seam (wave 7, two wide with 074). You own cmd/tk/cmd/cloud.go and its tests. 074 owns the terminal-state logic in run-workflow.ts — stay out of it. b6e refuses queue plus tick_ids with a 400 because the RunRoom's queued-submission storage has no tick_ids column, so the CLI should refuse that combination clearly rather than let an operator discover it as an HTTP error.
